Block-level cost tracking for CU, vote, writable account, and account data limits.

# Purpose
`fd_cost_tracker.h` defines the block-level cost tracking interface used by the runtime to enforce transaction and block limits. It declares `fd_cost_tracker_t`, which stores accumulated block cost, vote cost, and allocated account data size, together with the active limits for each category. The file also defines the cost limit constants, error codes, memory layout values, and helper functions used to create, join, initialize, and update a cost tracker. The inline function [`fd_cost_tracker_calculate_loaded_accounts_data_size_cost`](<#fd_cost_tracker_calculate_loaded_accounts_data_size_cost>) computes the cost of loaded account data for a transaction, and [`fd_cost_tracker_calculate_cost_and_add`](<#fd_cost_tracker_calculate_cost_and_add>) applies the transaction cost to the current block state.
